info.title: HOTEL PMS SAAS - SET setup contract (design)
info.description: Design contract for the property setup wizard (docs/94, SET-01..SET-06). Operations become implemented progressively; SET-03 implements draft save/resume and templates. No operation in this file is implemented until its SET package card and tests record it. Draft storage is server-side, scoped by tenant and property, revision-checked and idempotent; preview and simulation never create reservations or write inventory, and readiness is not activation.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Draft generation and revision as a quoted ETag "<draft_id>:<revision>". Required when a draft already exists; omit to create the first revision. A stale generation or revision fails with 412 SETUP_DRAFT_STALE and the current etag is returned in details.

Error.description: Safe error envelope with a stable code and correlation id

SetupTemplate.description: Server-owned catalog entry that maps a user-facing template to an existing resource type and safe defaults. Templates never create a parallel inventory engine.

SetupUnitGroup.description: One batch of equivalent units inside the draft. pattern expands server-side; exclusions remove numbers; duplicate codes inside or across groups are rejected.

privacy_ack.description: Required when rental_mode is WHOLE_OR_PARTS; the system never infers privacy from the unit name.

sharing_scope.description: Only MIXED is accepted until reservation intake enforces guest eligibility. Restricted FEMALE/MALE policies fail closed.

parts.description: Explicit user-declared parts for WHOLE_OR_PARTS villas and apartments. The server never infers bedrooms from the template.

connected_codes.description: Existing unit codes linked by a SUITE group. No resource is created and adjacency is never inferred.

SetupDraftInput.description: Partial wizard input. SaveSetupDraft accepts incomplete drafts (empty name, no unit group, missing pricing); completeness, privacy acknowledgment and sellability are enforced later by GetSetupReadiness and ApplySetupDraft, never by silently inventing values.

explicit_states.description: Must be true before apply; no bulk CLEAN assignment is inferred.

SetupDraft.description: Server-held wizard draft. One draft per property; every recreated draft gets a new draft_id so old-generation requests and replays cannot touch it; revision increments on every accepted save and drives If-Match together with draft_id.

SetupDraftPreview.description: Read-only expansion of the stored draft. preview_version is a digest binding the draft revision, the normalized draft input and inventory_version, so any material save or inventory change invalidates it. Apply must present a matching digest or fail closed with PREVIEW_STALE; the digest is not a preview counter and never proves validity by itself. V2 additionally binds tenant/property, location and resource state, allocations/blocks/exposure, composition state, operations policy and limits. New existing-location edits must use the location PATCH operation.

SetupReadiness.description: Server-computed gaps for the setup screen. Readiness is reporting plus explicit enforcement, not activation: ApplySetupDraft refuses with SETUP_READINESS_BLOCKED while blocking gaps exist, and changing a property with a stored incomplete draft to ACTIVE is refused with the same code until the draft is ready. Existing operations of running properties are not frozen, opening sale stays with the rate-plan operations and channel activation stays with its external gates.

SetupSimulationResult.description: Server-side exclusivity simulation. It creates no reservation, hold, block or journal entry.

SetupUnitGroupV2.description: Accepted for draft storage; not inventory execution. Missing choice/capacity is allowed in drafts, never a default. Cross-field matrix and readiness are service invariants. CATEGORY whole units only or beds within one room; parts/connected EXACT. Connected units require scoped existing IDs, connection_ack and effective dates. Bedrooms are descriptive, never inventory. No automatic migration of active whole units into parts.

explicit_states.description: Must be true before apply; no bulk CLEAN assignment is inferred.

SetupDraftInputV2.description: Version 2 draft input, accepted for save/read/discard only. Execution, preview and readiness fail closed until PSR-04. PUT replaces the complete input; omitted and null remain distinct. No inventory is written by saving a draft.

VersionedSetupDraftInput.description: v1 has no schema_version. v2 requires schema_version=2. Versions are preserved; no automatic upgrade or downgrade.

SetupUnitAdditionInput.description: PSR-04 additions to SETUP or ACTIVE property only. No edits to existing resources, property currency/timezone, operating policy, pricing or completed draft. New products follow existing activation/readiness gates.

put.summary: Save the setup draft with revision and idempotency protection
put.description: Creates the draft when absent or replaces it when the If-Match revision is current. The same Idempotency-Key with the same payload replays the stored response; the same key with a different payload fails with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

200.description: Saved draft with the next revision

409.description: CONFLICT when the same Idempotency-Key is reused with a different payload (details.reason = idempotency_key_reused)

412.description: SETUP_DRAFT_STALE when the If-Match revision is no longer current

delete.summary: Discard the draft without touching created inventory
delete.description: Requires the current draft etag when a draft exists; a stale or missing If-Match fails with 412 and the draft remains. Deleting an already absent draft is an idempotent success with removed=false.

200.description: The draft was removed or was already absent

412.description: SETUP_DRAFT_STALE when the If-Match generation or revision is no longer current

post.summary: Expand the stored draft into a read-only creation preview
post.description: Computes unit codes, per-template counts, duplicate and exclusion issues, and current blockers. Writes nothing and never creates a reservation. Reusing an existing villa, apartment or house code to change its whole/parts inventory shape fails with INVENTORY_TRANSFORMATION_REQUIRED (422).

200.description: Preview bound to the current draft revision and inventory version

404.description: SETUP_DRAFT_MISSING when the property has no stored draft

422.description: INVENTORY_TRANSFORMATION_REQUIRED when an existing villa, apartment or house would change between one whole resource and a container with sellable parts

post.summary: Create units, products and compositions from a reviewed preview
post.description: Re-validates permissions, property state (SETUP or ACTIVE), generation/revision, preview_version digest, limits and codes inside one transaction. An existing villa, apartment or house cannot be converted between one whole resource and parts through addition. A batch is bounded by the property limits profile; larger batches become resumable tasks with per-group results. No partial sellable inventory is left when a group fails. Idempotent replay with the same key returns the original successful result even if the draft changed afterwards; a first-time stale request fails closed.

200.description: Applied result with created counts and the next inventory version

409.description: CONFLICT for idempotency key reuse with different content or a concurrent apply (details.reason)

412.description: SETUP_DRAFT_STALE when the If-Match generation or revision is no longer current (details.current_etag), or PREVIEW_STALE when the presented preview_version digest no longer matches the current draft generation, revision, normalized input and inventory_version

422.description: SETUP_READINESS_BLOCKED when blocking gaps exist, SETUP_MODE_UNSUPPORTED when a rental mode is not implemented in this package, LIMIT_EXCEEDED when the property resource cap is exceeded, SETUP_BATCH_TASK_REQUIRED when the batch exceeds the inline apply limit, or INVENTORY_TRANSFORMATION_REQUIRED when a villa, apartment or house whole/parts conversion is attempted through addition

post.summary: Import unit rows with dry-run validation and optional apply
post.description: CSV columns: code,template,capacity,location. Dry-run writes no resources but does store the idempotency record for replay, and reports preflight code conflicts and limit breaches. APPLY re-validates inside one transaction, honours the inline batch limit and the property resource cap, refuses existing unit codes, and creates the accepted rows atomically; rejected rows are excluded by design, so atomicity covers the accepted set, not the whole file. Repeated APPLY of the same file is stopped by the code-collision check; repeated requests replay through Idempotency-Key. Only implemented templates are accepted; DORM and SUITE are rejected until their package exists.

200.description: Per-row import report; no partial creation on failure

409.description: CONFLICT when imported codes already exist as resources (details.codes)

422.description: SETUP_IMPORT_INVALID for unreadable files or no valid rows, SETUP_BATCH_TASK_REQUIRED above the inline limit, LIMIT_EXCEEDED above the resource cap, or CROSS_SCOPE_REFERENCE for unknown locations

limitations: Property activation checks the stored v1 or v2 setup readiness and fails closed on blocking gaps, including drafts with a stale completed flag.
Composition dates require both effective_from and effective_to.
Inline v2 budget includes resource, product, composition-leaf and new-location counts.
Browser-driven durable batches preserve completed steps; no background worker or global rollback.
Categories and compositions are indivisible; a group above the inline budget remains blocked.
